svg.aria-label: Boss battles: legacy monolith beaten with FastAPI microservices, unauthenticated endpoint beaten with Kong gateway and Lua plugins, sky-high cloud bill beaten with Lambda then Kubernetes

g.text: RAHUL used KONG GATEWAY + LUA PLUGINS!
Critical hit! Auth check: 2–3 s → 5–10 ms.
A wild SKY-HIGH CLOUD BILL appeared!
It's effective! Infra cost −30%, then −20% more.
